title: Two-point Loewner kernel of a generator (claimed fresh)
expression_sketch: Write G(z, H) = (H - z I)^{-1}. For spectral parameters x, y off the spectrum, G(x, H) - G(y, H) = (x - y) G(x, H) G(y, H). The first difference quotient is (G(x, H) - G(y, H))/(x - y) = G(x, H) G(y, H); when x = y the same object is G(x, H)^2.
latent_structure: First difference quotient of a resolvent in the spectral parameter, with the coincident node given by holomorphy on the resolvent set.

H.type: element of a unital Banach algebra

function_domains.G: G(·, H): rho(H) -> algebra, G(z, H) = (H - z I)^{-1}
